sources.note: Nothing; the document retires the code because 'There is no evidence that the language exists' — Wares to Grimes (1971) called Ponares 'non-existent', Ethnologue glossed it as a Sáliba surname, possibly a Piapoco or Achagua subgroup; absent from Adelaar 2004, Campbell 1997, Dixon & Aikhenvald 1999, Loukotka 1968, Crevels 2007, Voegelin & Voegelin 1977; Hammarström 2015 adds Landaburu 2000 and Ortiz 1965 for non-attestation.
